description:
rhythm is just a *click* away!

A free-to-win rhythm game. Rhythm is just a click away!

This is the future – and final – iteration of the osu! game client which marks the beginning of an
open era! Currently known by and released under the release codename "lazer". As in sharper than
cutting-edge.
What's Changed
- Move matchmaking pool fetching to QueueController by @LiquidPL in #39189
- Add store component for ranked play division data by @LiquidPL in #39163
- Update framework by @peppy in #39210
- Copy user setting for effect volume to hitsound volume by @peppy in #39208
